name: Nat Friedman
tagline: Former GitHub CEO backing AI-native products with Daniel Gross
summary: Nat Friedman co-founded Xamarin, sold it to Microsoft, and ran GitHub as CEO from 2018 to 2021 through the Copilot era. He then invested as one half of NFDG alongside Daniel Gross, a two-person partnership that wrote some of the earliest cheques into voice, image, music and coding AI companies. In mid-2025 both partners joined Meta's new Superintelligence Labs — Friedman as VP of Product & Applied Research, co-leading the unit with chief AI officer Alexandr Wang, and Gross leading the AI products division — after which NFDG stopped making new investments; the positions below are the disclosed ones from the partnership's active period.

thesis.heading: Two people, one decision
thesis.body: NFDG operated as a partnership of two operators rather than a fund with an investment process. Founders got a decision from the people who would actually help them, usually within a week.

thesis.heading: Product taste over market maps
thesis.body: The pattern across ElevenLabs, Suno and Cursor is the same: a product good enough that users adopt it before any enterprise sales motion exists.

thesis.heading: Developer tooling as home turf
thesis.body: Having shipped Copilot at GitHub, Friedman moved early on AI coding tools and on the inference and infrastructure layer they depend on.

thesis.heading: Access to research labs
thesis.body: The pair's credibility with researchers — and Gross's role as co-founder of Safe Superintelligence — gave them access to frontier labs that were not raising broadly.

portfolioGroups.heading: AI portfolio
portfolioGroups.blurb: Disclosed NFDG investments across generative media, AI coding tools, search and frontier research labs.

companies.name: ElevenLabs
companies.note: Text-to-speech and voice cloning models that became the default voice layer for AI products.

companies.name: Perplexity
companies.note: AI answer engine; one of the partnership's best-known early positions.

companies.name: Suno
companies.note: Generative music model producing full vocal tracks from text prompts.

companies.name: Cursor
companies.note: Anysphere's AI code editor; Friedman joined its OpenAI Startup Fund-led seed round in October 2023, a direct extension of his GitHub Copilot thesis.

companies.name: Character.AI
companies.note: Conversational AI characters with heavy consumer engagement.

companies.name: Safe Superintelligence
companies.note: Ilya Sutskever's research lab, co-founded by Daniel Gross, who led it as CEO until joining Meta in July 2025; NFDG took part in the lab's inaugural US$1B financing announced in September 2024.

companies.name: Figma
companies.note: Design platform now shipping generative design features across its product.

portfolioGroups.heading: Operating background
portfolioGroups.blurb: Not investments — the companies he built and ran, which explain the access and the developer-tooling focus.

companies.name: GitHub
companies.note: CEO from 2018 to 2021; launched Copilot, the first mass-market AI coding product.

companies.name: Xamarin
companies.note: Co-founder and CEO; cross-platform mobile development toolchain acquired by Microsoft in 2016.
